name: ASF Plugins
status: Two plugins for ArchiSteamFarm: one shipping, one a pre-release. Open source under {licence}.
lede: Plugins for ArchiSteamFarm. Each one drops into ASF's plugins directory, keeps its settings in ASF's own config files, and works in ASF's Docker image.
about: Plugins for ArchiSteamFarm: ASF-Notifier tells a Matrix room when a bot stops, loses its connection, finishes farming or ASF is updated, and ASF-PluginConfig, a pre-release, gives one page to edit other plugins' settings.
description: ASF Plugins: ASF-Notifier, which posts to a Matrix room when a bot stops, loses its connection, finishes farming or ASF is updated, and ASF-PluginConfig, a settings page for ASF plugins, now a pre-release. Free, open source, Apache-2.0.
summary: Plugins for ArchiSteamFarm: Matrix alerts when a bot stops, loses its connection or finishes farming, and a settings page for plugins, as a pre-release.

stack.label: Built against
stack.value: ArchiSteamFarm 6.3.10.6 (ASF-Notifier) and 6.3.11.7 (ASF-PluginConfig), with the .NET runtime ASF ships with

home.aria: {name}, plugins for ArchiSteamFarm: ASF-Notifier reports to a Matrix room

members.name: ASF-Notifier
members.lede: Hear about it when a bot stops. An ArchiSteamFarm plugin that posts to a Matrix room when a bot is stopped, loses its connection and comes back, finishes farming, or ASF is updated.

members.name: ASF-PluginConfig
members.lede: One page to edit the settings of the other installed plugins. A plugin that embeds a JSON Schema gets a form; one without gets a raw JSON editor for its key.

screenshots.alt: The page, listing one plugin with its global and bot settings, this plugin's own settings, the raw JSON card and the update button
screenshots.caption: One card per plugin with a schema, a raw JSON card for the rest, and the button that asks ASF to update plugins.
